verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document reusing a prior passed check to recognize a returning user. Flows reuse configuration, not results. Retrieving past results later is a building block a developer could use to construct reuse, not the capability itself. The 'biometric re-log in' comment appears to describe a different product.

support.subject: As a developer, a person verified once can be recognized and reused across sessions or products — documented re-verification and reuse of a prior passed check instead of forcing a full re-run
